Company Description AARGUS INFOTEC PRIVATE LIMITED is a technology company headquartered in NOIDA, India, with operations serving clients across diverse sectors. The organization focuses on delivering software and IT solutions that support business efficiency and digital transformation. Team members work in a collaborative environment that emphasizes technical excellence and practical problem-solving. The company values professionals who are eager to build robust products and contribute to long-term client relationships. Role Description  We are looking for a skilled and experienced Full Stack Developer with 4–5 years of hands-on experience in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Node.js, along with a good understanding of backend technologies such as Java and Python. The candidate will be responsible for developing responsive user interfaces, building robust backend services, integrating RESTful APIs, and implementing secure authentication mechanisms. The role requires someone who can independently manage frontend and backend development activities while collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions.  Key Responsibilities 1. Design, develop, and maintain responsive, scalable, and high-performance web applications using React.js and Next.js. 2. Build reusable UI components and frontend modules using TypeScript and Tailwind CSS. 3. Develop and maintain backend services, business logic, and server-side applications using Node.js. 4. Design, develop, and integrate RESTful APIs to enable seamless communication between frontend and backend systems. 5. Implement secure authentication and authorization mechanisms, including JWTbased authentication. 6. Work on API integrations, data handling, validation, and error management. 7. Optimize application performance, scalability, responsiveness, and overall user experience. 8. Collaborate with UI/UX designers, backend developers, QA engineers, and project stakeholders to deliver end-to-end solutions. 9. Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve application bugs, performance issues, and technical challenges. 10. Follow coding standards, maintain clean and reusable code, and participate in code reviews. 11. Work with databases and ensure efficient data storage, retrieval, and management. 12. Participate in technical discussions, requirement analysis, development planning, and deployment activities.  Skill Required React.js Strong hands-on experience in component-based development, Hooks, state management, and reusable components Next.js Experience with server-side rendering (SSR), static site generation (SSG), routing, and application optimization TypeScript Strong understanding of types, interfaces, generics, and type-safe application development Tailwind CSS Node.js Experience in building responsive and reusable UI layouts Hands-on experience in backend development, server-side programming, and building scalable services Java Python Working knowledge of Java and object-oriented programming concepts Working knowledge of Python and backend programming fundamentals REST APIs Experience in designing, developing, consuming, and integrating RESTful APIs Authentication Hands-on understanding of JWT, authentication, authorization, and secure API access  Additional Skills & Competencies Good understanding of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), and modern web development practices. Understanding of frontend state management solutions. Experience with Git and version control systems. Knowledge of database concepts, query handling, and data modeling. Familiarity with application debugging, testing, and performance optimization. Understanding of secure coding practices and web application security. Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in an agile development environment. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills Experience & Qualification Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (preferred).  4–5 years of relevant experience in full stack web application development. Strong hands-on experience in React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Node.js. Practical experience in developing and integrating REST APIs. Good understanding of authentication and authorization mechanisms, particularly JWT. Experience in handling end-to-end development activities, from frontend implementation to backend integration.
